text: QUALITY BULLETIN QB-368: Lot LOT-0191 (CHIP-IVI, supplier SUP-12) installed at P_IN on vehicles built 2027-03-02 to 2027-03-03 has a faulty weld. Place the lot on hold, stop sale of unsold vehicles and contact owners.
summary: E-15 is Quality hold. 1 lot(s) held, 25 dealer stop-sale call(s), 76 owner(s) contacted.
